The '''Dominus system''' was an uncharted [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==History==
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] science vessel ''[[Empirical]]'' was located in this system in [[2 BBY/Legends|2.5 BBY]], when it was plunged into the system's [[Star/Legends|star]] by [[PROXY]] to remove any evidence of [[Galen Marek]]'s continued existence.

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] traveled to the system. They visited [[Dominus III]], a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]], but were pursued by [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]].
